note: Atlas is 1024x1024 native; world coords = atlas px x 6. Overlay x,y is the sprite TOP-LEFT in world coords (matches shipped overlay_yeti2 at world 2940,1944 = atlas 490,324). Prop x,y is the ANCHOR position in world coords, with anchorX/anchorY the sprite-local anchor (matches shipped prop_black_gable). Every sprite is fully opaque-or-transparent (no partial alpha) and free of reserved teal #58D6C0 +-10.

assets.name: overlay_redwyrm
assets.placement: Volcano north shoulder, silhouetted against the ice shelf and teal water. MOVED from the shipped 736,306: at that spawn a red dragon on red volcanic rock is invisible (verified on the placement composite).

assets.name: overlay_redwyrm_breath
assets.placement: Over open sea east of the volcano cliff, so the plume reads against blue water. Frames 0-2 are a hard-edged orange-white cone, 3-5 the plume balloons, 6-7 it collapses to dark smoke. Source frame 8 was DROPPED: the dragon itself vanishes from it.

assets.name: overlay_stormdrake
assets.supersedes: env/overlay_stormdrake (was 72x32, 9f, bat-winged palette swap of the red)
assets.placement: Frostmere circuit, over the ice shelf. New anatomy: long serpentine body, four feathered fin-wings, spined crest, slate blue-grey with a pale belly. Shifted 30px west of ART-03's 380,190 to clear the ice tower at atlas 452.

assets.name: overlay_stormdrake_breath
assets.placement: The storm-coast play near the Storm House, in the slot the old stormdrake vacates when its primary path moves north. Forked white-core arc fires on frames 0-1, then the serpent flies on - use playLoops 1 so the strike reads as the entrance event.

assets.name: prop_ice_tower
assets.placement: N2 crag on the ice shelf. MOVED for FINAL-04 #4: the shipped anchor put the tower’s base at atlas y=252, eighty pixels BELOW its named crag (measured at 452-490 x 153-178 on the current composite), so the crag floated above the spire. The anchor is now the crag foot, atlas (468,177).

assets.name: overlay_ice_beacon
assets.placement: Drawn at exactly the prop_ice_tower rect, which moved with the tower. overlay_ice_beacon_f0.png stays BYTE-IDENTICAL to prop_ice_tower.png, so the tower never blinks.

assets.name: prop_fairy_castle
assets.placement: Whispering Woods canopy NNW of the WW marker, anchored at its own base. RE-AUTHORED for FINAL-04 #3: the 96x80 predecessor was an isometric diorama tile — four straight edges, an extruded soil side wall, and internal oak crowns at ~28 px against the map’s ~10 px canopy. This is a flat map keep with no plinth, no ground plate and no side wall, at 31x39 the smallest landmark prop on the atlas. Authored with create_map_object against a 64x48 crop of the site itself, so it carries the map’s own palette.

assets.name: overlay_fairy_motes
assets.placement: Whispering Woods canopy immediately west of the castle. MOVED off the brown scree at atlas 378-410 x 420-452 (FINAL-04 #6) and TONED: the four shipped frames are desaturated 35% toward their own luma with a honey-green cast, so six round gold bodies stop reading as struck coins. Deterministic remap, no pixel moved (tools/worldfix-prep.js). NOT FIXED: they are still discs rather than winged silhouettes — two re-authoring rolls were rejected (an opaque scene; six 8x5 orange insects) and the cap stopped a third. Next round: roll at 16x16, which forces a 2-3 px body.

assets.name: prop_storm_house
assets.placement: SW Gloaming knoll, anchored at its own base. RE-AUTHORED for FINAL-04 #3: the 56x64 predecessor was an isometric diorama on a soil plinth. This is one dark roof with a lit window seen from above, no plate, no side wall. overlay_storm_lightning moved with it so the bolt still ends on this roof.

assets.name: overlay_storm_lightning
assets.placement: Over the storm house’s roof, MOVED with the house. The sprite is unchanged.

assets.name: overlay_deer2
assets.placement: W1 taper, woods EDGE. RE-AUTHORED at map scale for FINAL-04 #5 (48x40 -> 16x16, contact shadow baked in), and the loop restored once the cap was raised: animate_image d41aef2d, 5 frames, the doe lifting and lowering her head while the fawn shifts. No longer a static marker.

assets.name: overlay_bear3
assets.placement: Longwood interior, south of the shipped overlay_bear2 (atlas 340,592). Full four-legged amble cycle.

assets.name: overlay_yeti3
assets.placement: Snow field south of the floe leads, atlas 600,190 — MOVED off N3’s open lead (FINAL-04 #4) and RE-AUTHORED at map scale (44x40 -> 16x17, FINAL-04 #5). Loop restored: animate_image 5afb2ef9, 5 frames, a slow shoulder sway.

assets.name: overlay_wolfpair
assets.placement: Wolfwood, in place and UNCHANGED at 56x44. FINAL-04 #5 asked for a halved canvas; two rolls at 28x28 both failed the same way the first round’s did — one came back on a hard isometric snow diamond, one as an unreadable grey blob — so the accepted full-size pair stays rather than shipping a plate the round exists to remove (ART-03 §7 two-failure stop).

assets.name: overlay_wagon
assets.placement: HR-to-Whispering-Woods road. RE-AUTHORED at map scale (32x32 -> 14x13) and now ANIMATED: animate_image 017b3d4a, 5 frames of the oxen plodding and the wagon rocking, six loops per play so the 12 s of travel it had as a still is preserved.

assets.name: overlay_crows
assets.placement: Forgotten Hollow, over the standing stones. Verified legible on the atlas composite - dark bird marks read against the green, which is why they go here and not over dark forest.

assets.name: overlay_snowdrift
assets.placement: NW snow country. Powder curl lifts, scatters and settles to almost nothing by the last frame (1107 -> 486 opaque px).

assets.name: overlay_lantern
assets.placement: Haven's Rest settlement life. Continuous is acceptable at this size, but atlas x 450 is inside the J-3 band - integrator may prefer playLoops 4 / intervalMillis 9000. Canvas is 16x16, not the requested 12x12: PixelLab rejects any side below 16.

assets.name: overlay_chimney_smoke2
assets.placement: Haven's Rest rooftop. WARNING: this sprite includes a small chimney pot at its base, so it must sit ON a roofline, never on open ground.

assets.name: overlay_fishing_boat
assets.placement: Open water east of the lighthouse headland - MOVED from 700,640, which put the hull on land. Rocks on the swell with a shifting waterline ripple.
